observations.seen: Rectangular ceiling strip lights with large soft glow sprites, but the walls and floor are lit by a flat ambient term with no directional falloff. There is no key/rim separation at 70°/210°, and enemies and props read as flat silhouettes.
Barrels, crates and enemy figures have no contact shadows or cast shadows on the floor. Only faint dark smudges appear at their bases, so objects look like they float.

The floor has a blotchy, wet-looking noise texture that suggests reflectivity but mirrors nothing in the scene. The pistol shows faint specular highlights. No environment reflections are visible on metal surfaces.

Long, empty box corridors with one repeated wall texture, a pipe trim and yellow floor stripes. The props are a few red barrels, crates and a blue container. The circular vault door in frames 3 and 4 is the only landmark. The scene is an underground bunker, not a deep space blue arena.
Haze halos around the ceiling lights and a murky volume toward the ceiling, against a recipe of no atmosphere. The haze adds no depth cue to the gameplay space.

The plaster walls are a low-detail flat texture, the stone wall in frame 3 is stretched and repeats visibly, and the floor is a smeared noise pattern. The pistol has a noisy speckled grip texture and teal emissive strips that are its best material.

Room geometry is plain extruded boxes. Enemies are small, low-detail humanoids. The barrels and crates are simple primitives. The pistol with its underbarrel attachment is a reasonable mid-poly asset.
The left half of frames 1, 2 and 4 is a blank wall. The enemies take up under 2% of the frame at the far end, and the weapon model takes the visual weight instead of the field of play.
First-person perspective camera with a wide FOV. The recipe calls for an orthographic top-down 60° view with the field at 10–15% of the frame, so the camera does not match the genre.

Heavy film grain, faint horizontal scanline banding across the ceiling, and a vignette. The color grade swings from neutral/warm to teal to strong orange between frames, which muddies contrast instead of producing a space grade.
There is no health, ammo, score or wave readout. The only visible UI is a tiny crosshair marker and painted floor labels ('B-1 STONE GATEHOUSE', 'B-3 FORGE HALLS').
